newsitem.title: ITALY: UBS starts asset management in Italy.
newsitem.headline: UBS starts asset management in Italy.

text.p: Swiss banking group UBS is starting asset management in Italy under its UBS Italia SpA unit and aims to manage up to 300 billion lire in a year, UBS Italia director general Massimo Beffa said.
UBS already has authorisation from the Bank of Italy and will start with 40 billion lire of capital.

Beffa told reporters UBS Italia will offer UBS funds as well as those of other groups starting from a minimum of 200 million lire, with insurance products deriving from an agreement between UBS and Swiss Life expected to be on offer soon.
More long term, Beffa said UBS intends to create or buy a distribution network and to explore potential for pension funds and institutional investor consultancy.
